entries.title: Genesis 22:1
segments: ¶Now it came to pass after these things that God tested Abraham, and said to him, "Abraham!" And he said, "Here I am."

entries.title: Genesis 22:2
segments: Then He said, "Take now your son, your only [son] Isaac, whom you love, and go to the land of Moriah, and offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains of which I shall tell you."

entries.title: Genesis 22:3
segments: ¶So Abraham rose early in the morning and saddled his donkey, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son; and he split the wood for the burnt offering, and arose and went to the place of which God had told him.

entries.title: Genesis 22:4
segments: Then on the third day Abraham lifted his eyes and saw the place afar off.

entries.title: Genesis 22:5
segments: And Abraham said to his young men, "Stay here with the donkey; the lad and I will go yonder and worship, and we will come back to you."

entries.title: Genesis 22:6
segments: So Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering and laid [it] on Isaac his son; and he took the fire in his hand, and a knife, and the two of them went together.

entries.title: Genesis 22:7
segments: But Isaac spoke to Abraham his father and said, "My father!" And he said, "Here I am, my son." Then he said, "Look, the fire and the wood, but where [is] the lamb for a burnt offering?"

entries.title: Genesis 22:8
segments: And Abraham said, "My son, God will provide for Himself the lamb for a burnt offering." So the two of them went together.

entries.title: Genesis 22:9
segments: Then they came to the place of which God had told him. And Abraham built an altar there and placed the wood in order; and he bound Isaac his son and laid him on the altar, upon the wood.

entries.title: Genesis 22:10
segments: And Abraham stretched out his hand and took the knife to slay his son.

entries.title: Genesis 22:11
segments: ¶But the Angel of the LORD called to him from heaven and said, "Abraham, Abraham!" So he said, "Here I am."

entries.title: Genesis 22:12
segments: And He said, "Do not lay your hand on the lad, or do anything to him; for now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your son, your only [son], from Me."

entries.title: Genesis 22:13
segments: Then Abraham lifted his eyes and looked, and there behind [him was] a ram caught in a thicket by its horns. So Abraham went and took the ram, and offered it up for a burnt offering instead of his son.

entries.title: Genesis 22:14
segments: And Abraham called the name of the place, The-LORD-Will-Provide; as it is said [to] this day, "In the Mount of The LORD it shall be provided."

entries.title: Genesis 22:15
segments: ¶Then the Angel of the LORD called to Abraham a second time out of heaven,

entries.title: Genesis 22:16
segments: and said: "By Myself I have sworn, says the LORD, because you have done this thing, and have not withheld your son, your only [son] -

entries.title: Genesis 22:17
segments: "blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply your descendants as the stars of the heaven and as the sand which [is] on the seashore; and your descendants shall possess the gate of their enemies.

entries.title: Genesis 22:18
segments: "In your seed all the nations of the earth shall be blessed, because you have obeyed My voice."

entries.title: Genesis 22:19
segments: So Abraham returned to his young men, and they rose and went together to Beersheba; and Abraham dwelt at Beersheba.

entries.title: Genesis 22:20
segments: ¶Now it came to pass after these things that it was told Abraham, saying, "Indeed Milcah also has borne children to your brother Nahor:

entries.title: Genesis 22:21
segments: "Huz his firstborn, Buz his brother, Kemuel the father of Aram,

entries.title: Genesis 22:22
segments: "Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel."

entries.title: Genesis 22:23
segments: And Bethuel begot Rebekah. These eight Milcah bore to Nahor, Abraham's brother.

entries.title: Genesis 22:24
segments: His concubine, whose name was Reumah, also bore Tebah, Gaham, Thahash, and Maachah.
